meta.description: Map nucleosome center positions, occupancy, and fuzziness from ATAC-seq fragment-size patterns using NucleoATAC, ATACseqQC, DANPOS3, or scprinter. Use when characterizing nucleosome organization at promoters and enhancers, calling +1/-1 nucleosomes flanking NFRs, generating V-plots for chromatin structure visualization, or comparing nucleosome positioning between conditions.

scientific_integrity.detail: Unsourced H2A.Z and yeast +1 figures removed or labelled untested; measured values stated in the Skill (178 calls, +121 bp median) match this re-run

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only genomics Skill with no clinical conclusions

methodological_ground.detail: V-plot centring and strand handling verified against independent recounts; DANPOS3 columns and filter reproduce planted truth

code_usability.detail: estimate_nrl.py, vplot.py and nucleosome_analysis.R run on real GM12878 data; the NucleoATAC route runs from a clean install with a precisely specified, disclosed one-line edit and a stated fallback

functional_suitability.note: Scripts and both routes run on real data; NucleoATAC calls need a disclosed third-party edit

reliability.note: Failure guards present and exercised; NRL plateau ambiguity and export/summary count mismatch remain

performance_context.note: Short SKILL.md with routed references; method reference is long but sectioned

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow, columns and post-run nucpos check named; scPrinter has no command

human_usability.note: Example requests, tested versions and decision table; patch steps are copy-paste

security.note: No credentials or network calls; one documented edit of installed third-party source inside an isolated env

maintainability.note: License and provenance kept; tested versions stated; unmaintained upstream noted

agent_specific.note: Trigger-rich description; claims sourced or labelled untested

key_strengths: All three prior P0 code defects are fixed and reproduced independently on real GM12878 chr1 data (estimate_nrl 178 vs 176 bp; R pipeline rc 0 with all outputs; V-plot recount within 0.04 percent)

The NucleoATAC route works from a clean install: the Skill names the upstream defect, gives an idempotent sed plus rebuild, warns that unpatched runs exit 0 with empty nucpos, and offers occupancy/NFR outputs and DANPOS3 as fallbacks
Failure guards (no periodicity, single-end, unknown chromosome) give actionable messages instead of tracebacks
The DANPOS3 differential filter copied from the doc recovers 90.3 percent of planted shifts with 0 false calls

recommendations.title: NRL estimator: flag broad or ambiguous mono plateaus
recommendations.problem: On GM12878 rep2 estimate_nrl.py reports 208 bp while the 1-bp mode is 177 bp because the mono region is a 185-235 bp plateau with a 175 bp shoulder; no warning is given.
recommendations.root_cause: The tallest 5 bp-bin peak in 150-250 bp is reported without a peak-quality or shoulder check.
recommendations.fix: Print the 1-bp mode next to the binned value, or warn when two candidates within the window differ by more than about 15 bp. (NUCPOS-016)

recommendations.title: R exports and summary CSV use different class assignments
recommendations.problem: Exported NFR/mono BAM pair counts differ from nfr_count/mono_count in the summary (141,651 vs 130,774; 64,579 vs 67,604).
recommendations.root_cause: Counts come from unshifted alignments; exports come from post-shift splitGAlignmentsByCut classes.
recommendations.fix: State the difference in a script comment or usage note, or compute the summary from the exported classes. (NUCPOS-017)

recommendations.title: NucleoATAC calls still need a third-party source edit
recommendations.problem: The unmaintained upstream calculateCov leaves its accumulator uninitialised, so calls exist only after the documented one-line edit and rebuild.
recommendations.root_cause: Upstream defect with no released fix; not repairable inside the Skill.
recommendations.fix: Keep the disclosure and fallback; optionally file the upstream issue and record its URL in the method reference. (NUCPOS-006, accepted workaround)

recommendations.title: scPrinter route remains untested
recommendations.problem: scPrinter is named for single-cell and per-base use but no command or test ships; the Skill says so.
recommendations.root_cause: Out of bounded scope (GPU, source install).
recommendations.fix: Keep the untested label or add a tested minimal workflow later. (NUCPOS-015, deferred)
